# Generated by Dev Stuff/Tools/build_artifact_browser.py. Edit the builder, then regenerate.
# The parent gates all work while closed. No per-frame province/world scans.
custom_button = {
    name = war_artifact_browser_open
    potential = { ai = no }
    trigger = { }
    tooltip = war_artifact_browser_open_tt
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = war_artifact_browser_open } }
                war_artifact_rebuild_locations = yes
            }
            set_country_flag = war_artifact_browser_open
            clr_country_flag = war_adventurer_browser_open
        }
    }
}
custom_window = {
    name = war_artifact_browser_window
    potential = { ai = no has_country_flag = war_artifact_browser_open }
}

    name = war_artifact_browser_close
    potential = { always = yes }
    trigger = { }
    tooltip = war_artifact_browser_close_tt
    effect = { clr_country_flag = war_artifact_browser_open }
}

custom_button = {
    name = war_artifact_browser_ghal_maraz_owned
    potential = { exists = event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz = { has_province_modifier = location_of_the_ghal_maraz owned_by = FROM } }
    tooltip = war_artifact_browser_ghal_maraz_tt
    trigger = { }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { AND = { exists = event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz = { has_province_modifier = location_of_the_ghal_maraz } } } }
                war_artifact_rebuild_locations = yes
            }
            clr_country_flag = war_artifact_browser_open
            if = {
                limit = { exists = event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz = { has_province_modifier = location_of_the_ghal_maraz } }
                event_target:war_artifact_location_ghal_maraz = { save_event_target_as = war_artifact_browser_province }
                country_event = { id = war_artifact_browser.1 }
            }
            else = { country_event = { id = war_artifact_browser.101 } }
        }
    }
}

    potential = { exists = event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges = { has_province_modifier = location_of_the_book_of_grudges owned_by = FROM } }
    tooltip = war_artifact_browser_book_of_grudges_tt
    trigger = { }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { AND = { exists = event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges = { has_province_modifier = location_of_the_book_of_grudges } } } }
                war_artifact_rebuild_locations = yes
            }
            clr_country_flag = war_artifact_browser_open
            if = {
                limit = { exists = event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges = { has_province_modifier = location_of_the_book_of_grudges } }
                event_target:war_artifact_location_book_of_grudges = { save_event_target_as = war_artifact_browser_province }
                country_event = { id = war_artifact_browser.10 }
            }
            else = { country_event = { id = war_artifact_browser.110 } }
        }
    }
}
